messages:
alex: Pager alert — elevated genqueue tail latency in US-EAST, paging @oncall-sre
incident-bot: Incident INC-5123 created • priority: P1 • assignee: @oncall-sre • channel: #incidents
oncall-sre: joining bridge now. any recent deploys or config changes?
emma: no deploys in last 45m. metrics: queue depth spike on genqueue, cache eviction rate up, cpu on pool-east-2 elevated
ops-scribe: drafting initial statuspage copy. rough: ```We are investigating increased latency affecting streaming completions in US-EAST. Some requests may experience delays or interrupted streams. Engineers are triaging the genqueue layer.```
support-lead: add customer impact + guidance: call out which workloads affected and recommend short non-stream completions as a temporary workaround
legal: wording note — avoid absolutes like "will" for timelines. prefer "we will provide regular updates." Replace "interrupted" with "interrupted or delayed"? avoid promising retries will resolve.
ops-scribe: updated draft, added mitigations section:
ops-scribe: ```Mitigations in progress:
• Added 3 instances to pool-east-2
• Rerouted new session traffic to US-WEST where capacity is available
• Enabled temporary fallback to small-latency model for latency-first routes
• Rolling a canary patch to reduce KV cache churn in genqueue
```
oncall-sre: canary deploy started. monitoring for errors and latency. if stable we'll promote to the pool in ~15-25m. no rollback needed at this time
alex: should we publish the initial notice? legal signoff required
legal: reviewed and approved (see wording tweak). do not include ETA promises.
ops-scribe: final statuspage draft ready to publish:
ops-scribe: ```We are investigating elevated latency and intermittent streaming interruptions in the US-EAST inference cluster. Impact: streaming and long-completion requests may be delayed or interrupted for some customers in US-EAST. Mitigations: additional capacity added to pool-east-2, new sessions routed to US-WEST, temporary fallback to a lower-latency model for latency-sensitive routes, and a targeted fix rolling in canary to address cache churn. Next update: when the canary completes or in 20 minutes. Incident ID: INC-5123.```
alex: publishing initial status now
incident-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-5123 • update cadence: 20m
support-lead: support ticket template for agents:
support-lead: ```We are aware of increased latency for streaming responses in US-EAST. Engineering has scaled capacity and enabled fallbacks. We will update this ticket as mitigation progresses. Incident ID: INC-5123.```
oncall-sre: canary stable for 10 minutes, promoting to pool. observing p50/p95 steadily improving
emma: p95 trending down to baseline, queue depth dropping. continuing to observe for 10m before resolve
ops-scribe: resolved notice draft:
ops-scribe: ```Resolved: The issue impacting streaming completions in US-EAST has been mitigated. Root cause: KV cache churn in genqueue caused by hot-prefixes; we deployed a targeted fix and scaled capacity. If you continue to see problems, please open a support ticket. Incident ID: INC-5123.```
legal: approved
alex: publishing resolved notice. great job all.
incident-bot: Incident INC-5123 resolved • duration: ~33m • archives updated
